patterns.name: Ahmes/Lambert subseries boundary map
patterns.one_liner: Ahmes/Lambert subseries topology clarifies nearby Erdos irrationality questions and first-power boundaries, but does not supply the #249 signed second-power denominator mechanism.
patterns.adoption_action: Record as an open-problem and first-power Lambert-subseries boundary, not as the active #249 denominator route.
patterns.rejection_reason: Wrong direct-transfer regime: first-power 0/1 Lambert subseries and topological rationality constructions, not signed finite Euler-sieve zeta_q(2) combinations.
patterns.reevaluation_trigger: Reopen if #249 work needs a broader Lambert subseries open-problem register or a comparison to omega(n)/2^n-style prime-support series.
patterns.relevance_justification: Useful to prevent conflating #249 with first-power Lambert subseries and Ahmes/open-problem cartography.

patterns.name: Erdos257 strict separation and unique support coding
patterns.one_liner: For every fixed base t at least 2, Lambert-subseries weights are strictly superincreasing, so supports code distinct points in a Cantor set.
patterns.adoption_action: Use as literature authority for strong separation and uniqueness; keep base-2 measure one and gap asymptotics attributed to the July referee synthesis pending formalization.
patterns.relevance_justification: Direct prior-art anchor for the #257 geometric branch.
